{{Quote|Charmed.|Zavrasha|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Zavrasha''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Female]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Pureblood]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Darth Mortis]]' apprentice. She was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to check the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] technological advances. There she tasked a fellow Imperial to destroy these advances, but asked to strike swiftly and anonymously to not jeopardize the [[Treaty of Coruscant|Treaty]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zavrasha is voiced by [[Lydia Leonard]], who also provides the voice for [[Lana Beniko]] in the game. Male characters have the option to flirt with her, potentially leading to a private scene between the two.<ref name="TOR" />
